title: Rory and the Silver Shore
verses:
When the moon floated high over valleys of blue,
And Psittaco chirped from a nest in the tree,
He called to his friends through the cool night-time dew,
"Come follow the path to the silvery sea!"

Sweet Nia soared down with her wings spreading wide,
While Benny walked slow with a heavy, soft tread.
Big Rory trod softly right close by her side,
To search for a spot where the moss made a bed.

Gentle Tilly stopped short where the silver reeds grew,
Beside a quiet lake where the stars seemed to sleep.
The breeze blew a lullaby sweet, soft, and new,
Across the calm water so still and so deep.

Brave Ricky stretched out as he lowered his chin,
And rested his head on his strong, sturdy paw.
He gave all his friends a most drowsy, warm grin,
The coziest nighttime that anyone saw.

Tiny Psittaco tucked under Nia’s warm wing,
As Benny let out a contented, deep sigh.
The night crickets gathered together to sing,
Beneath the bright silver that filled up the sky.

Friendly Rory yawned big as he settled to rest,
While starlight drifted down on his gentle green skin.
Each friend was tucked safely where each loved the best,
As dreams of tomorrow were about to begin.
